data.Name: Rebuilding the Business
data.Description: Help the merchant gather materials to rebuild their trading stall
data.Template_Text: [NPC1] needs your help one last time. Their trading stall was wrecked during the robbery, and they need [Junk1] to patch it back together. Scavenge the area near [Location1] and bring back what you can find!
data.2nd_state_Template_Text: With the [Junk1] you gathered, [NPC1] has rebuilt their stall near [Location1]. The merchant is back in business and eternally grateful. They press some extra supplies into your hands as thanks.
